triggers.name: scheduled_event
triggers.title: New recurring event
triggers.help: Run your recipe on a regular interval (e.g. every 15 minutes), or on a set schedule (e.g. at 9:00AM every week on Monday). Users may also specify a cron expression by selecting Custom schedule in the "Time unit" dropdown. The minimum accepted interval is every 5 minutes.

input.name: time_unit
input.label: Time unit
input.hint: Select an interval or custom schedule to specify cron expression.

output.name: on_demand
output.label: On demand
output.hint: True when the job was triggered via the on-demand API.

triggers.name: scheduled_event_v2
triggers.title: New recurring event (V2)
triggers.help: Checks for new events every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes.

input.name: trigger_every
input.label: Trigger every
input.hint: Enter a whole number. The minimum interval is 5 minutes or 1 hour.

input.name: interval_alignment
input.label: At minute
input.hint: Enter a minute from 0 to 59 to align the schedule in your timezone. Leave blank to start one interval after activation.

input.name: on_overlap
input.label: When all concurrency slots are busy

input.name: on_schedule_apply
input.label: When the schedule starts or changes

output.name: on_demand
output.label: On demand
output.hint: True when the job was triggered via the on-demand API.

actions.name: get_time
actions.title: Get current time
actions.description: Get the current time in workspace timezone
actions.help: Action will return the time when it was executed in (GMT-08:00) Pacific Time (US & Canada) timezone. This action is useful for testing triggers.

output.name: time
output.label: Time
output.hint: The current time in ISO 8601 (YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS+/-HHMM) format

actions.name: wait_for_interval
actions.title: Wait for time duration
actions.description: Wait for specified length of time
actions.help: The job pauses for the specified length of time before carrying out subsequent actions in the recipe. Maximum time a job can be configured to remain paused is 732 days. Learn more .

actions.name: wait_until_time
actions.title: Wait until specified time
actions.help: The job pauses until the specified time before carrying out subsequent actions in the recipe. The specified time will be in the workspace's timezone, {{authUser.account_timezone}} . Maximum time a job can be configured to remain paused is 732 days. Learn more .
